integrity: A complete uniform proof is provided; a finite exhaustive standard-library test verifies n=4 through 11 but is not substituted for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced general-position plane-line divisors with transitive single-cycle Frobenius are covered, for n at least four. This concerns connected Picard tori, not ambient Picard groups or Neron components. The historical priority check is provisional and a further independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Cyclic Frobenius Picard tori of nodal line divisors: a nonsplit parity lattice
